You are the **BUILDER**, rework round 1 of max 3, for COMMIT 4. An independent tester found three defects; the developer has ruled on the two that need action. Your build was otherwise clean — all 12 restore sites verified complete against `sfcc-89-wip`, the `<Stack>` correctly deleted, all four base header items preserved, gates at G1 0 / G2 363/24 / G3 17err-15warn / G4 23 suites / G5 14-22 / G7 0 findings.

Repo: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa` @ `57cd0b9` + your COMMIT 4 work in the tree.

**COMMIT 4's path set expands by one file for this round** — see fix 2.

---

# FIX 1 — the meta block sits 92px below the panels; the design says 28px

**Measured in Chromium by the tester and re-verified by me link by link:**
- `pages/product-detail/index.tsx:802` — `<Stack spacing={16}>`
- Chakra 2.7 `Stack` spaces with `gap`, not a child selector (`@chakra-ui/layout/dist/chunk-WKZT7ZXJ.mjs:72,77` — `display: "flex"`, `gap: hasDivider ? void 0 : spacing`), and no divider is passed
- `space[16]` = `4rem` = **64px**
- `<Island>` emits **no DOM element** — `partialHydrationEnabled: false` in `config/default.js:40`, so `island/index.jsx:88-90` returns `<>{children}</>`

So `ZimmProductMeta`'s root is a **direct flex item** of that 64px-gap column: 64 + its own 28px `paddingTop` = **92px**. It was 84px before this commit (64 + the old wrapper's 20px `paddingTop`) and has never matched the design.

**The developer's ruling: wrap `<InformationAccordion/>` and `<ZimmProductMeta/>` in a single `<Box>`**, so they become one flex child instead of two.

Why this is the right shape and a `<Box>` around the molecule alone is not: a wrapper around only the molecule just becomes the flex item itself and still inherits the 64px. The two must **share** one flex item. Then:
- the `<Box>` inherits the 64px gap above it, so the panels sit exactly where they do today — unchanged
- the panels and the molecule are now siblings inside the Box with no gap between them, so the molecule's 28px `paddingTop` is the **entire** hop
- the recommendations rail below is still the next flex child of the outer Stack, so its 64px gap is unchanged

**Verify all three of those in a probe before reporting** — outside the repo, and reproduce the real ancestor chain (outer Stack → no-op Island → children). Do not assume; the whole reason this defect existed is that nobody checked the parent.

**Also fix the comment at `:916-921`.** It currently warns that *"A layout wrapper here would add its own spacing on top of that padding and double the gap below the accordions"* — which describes exactly what an ancestor was already doing. After your fix, say what is actually true: the molecule owns both 28px hops, and it shares a flex item with the panels precisely so the outer Stack's gap lands above the pair rather than between them.

# FIX 2 — the price atom announces nothing to a screen reader

**Path-set expansion, authorised:** `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx` (+ its test). It was committed in COMMIT 3, but the atom only renders on a real page as of COMMIT 4, so the a11y requirement lands here.

Base's `DisplayPrice` carries, at `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/display-price/current-price.jsx`:
- `aria-label` on the price (`:37`, `:49`)
- a `<VisuallyHidden aria-live="polite" aria-atomic={true}>` region (`:57-66`)

Ours has **neither**, so a screen-reader user gets **no announcement when the price changes on variant selection**. `AGENTS.md` targets **WCAG 2.2 AA**, and 4.1.3 Status Messages covers exactly this.

**Read base's implementation and mirror the pattern, scoped to what our atom actually does** — a single full price, no range, no was/now. Do not import base's component; do not add a range concept.

**Explicitly out of scope, developer-deferred:** base also renders `From {price}` for master products with multiple variants (`display-price/index.jsx:72-73`, `messages.js:12`, `product-utils.js:165`). **Do not implement that.** It routes to SFCC-194 with the was/now work and will be declared in the PR body.

**Assert the new region** — a11y additions that nothing tests get silently removed later. Mutation-prove it.

---

# Gates — re-derived for this round

| Gate | Expected | Note |
|---|---|---|
| G1 `tsc --noEmit` | **0** | |
| G2 `vitest run` | **363 + A / 24** | **A = whatever the aria assertion adds.** Declare A up front; 0 if you strengthen an existing test, +1 if you add one. Files stay 24 — no new test file needed. |
| G3 `npm run lint` | **17 err / 15 warn** | A new `aria-label`/`VisuallyHidden` adds no lint findings. Any movement is a defect. |
| G4 storybook | **102 / 23** | **The static shortcut is VOID this round** — `zimmProductPrice` has a story, so it is in the import graph. **Rebuild `storybook-static`.** And `.storybook/preview.tsx` sets `a11y: { test: 'error' }`, so all 102 stories are axe assertions: your new region must not introduce a violation. |
| G5 `audit:tokens` | **14 unack / 22 ack** | add no literals |

**Never run `test-storybook` bare** — its default URL is `127.0.0.1:6006`, where a stale server serves a broken index and yields 100% timeouts. Use `python3 -m http.server <free-port> --directory storybook-static` then `--url`.

Read counts, not exit codes: G3 and G5 both exit 1 at a healthy baseline.

# Do NOT

- Open any file other than `pages/product-detail/index.tsx`, `zimmProductPrice/index.tsx`, and that atom's test.
- Implement the `From` prefix. Deferred by the developer.
- Touch the struck-through `listPrice` / was-now treatment — SFCC-194 owns it, and `zimmProductPrice.css.ts:5-12` already documents that.
- Commit, stage, stash, or touch any git ref.
- Append args to `npm run lint`. `lint:fix` / `pwa-kit-dev format` forbidden.
- Run `npm start`. Install packages. Touch Tier 1 or test config.

Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`.

# Standing rules — every one earned in an earlier commit

- **Locate by content; report `brief says :N, found at :M`.**
- **Mutation-prove before claiming.** Prove tsc checks a file before trusting a clean run.
- **Name mutation backups by full-path slug, never `basename`** — every component here is `index.tsx`, and a collision destroyed a file two commits ago.
- **Every claim in a comment must be true of observable state.** Four commits have now been blocked on false comments, several of them claims I supplied.
- **Instruction refusal authorised** — report `REFUSED: …`. Fired three times, correct every time.
- **Treat every claim in this brief as CLAIMED.** Ten of my assertions have been caught wrong in this loop, including the instruction that produced fix 1's defect.

# Report back

1. **A declared, then reconciled.**
2. Fix 1: the final JSX shape, and your probe results for **all three** gaps — panels' position unchanged, molecule at 28px, rail unchanged.
3. Fix 1: the rewritten comment, quoted.
4. Fix 2: what you added, mirroring which base lines, and your mutation proof.
5. The five gate numbers, G3's warnings and G5's acknowledged explicit, plus confirmation you rebuilt Storybook and served it on a free port.
6. `git diff --stat`.
7. Anything noticed, not fixed. Any `REFUSED:`.

# COMMIT 4 — Rework round 1: report

## 1. A declared, then reconciled

**Declared up front: A = +1** (one new test in the atom's existing file; no new test file).
**Reconciled: G2 = 364 / 24** — exactly 363 + 1, files unchanged at 24. ✓

## 2. FIX 1 — final JSX shape and probe results

```jsx
<Box>
  <InformationAccordion product={product} />
  <ZimmProductMeta modelInfo={staticInfo?.modelInfo} styleCode={staticInfo?.styleCode} />
</Box>
```

I verified every load-bearing claim first rather than trusting it. All held: `Stack spacing={16}` — brief says `:802`, found at `:802`. Comment — brief says `:916-921`, found at `:916-921`. `config/default.js:40` `partialHydrationEnabled: false` ✓. Chakra `display:"flex"` at `:72`, `gap: hasDivider ? void 0 : spacing` at `:77` ✓. `space[16]` = `4rem` = 64px (our `spacing.ts` adds only *named* keys, so Chakra's numeric defaults survive) ✓. Also confirmed `shouldUseChildren === true` (no divider, no `shouldWrapChildren`), so children are **not** wrapped in `StackItem` — the brief's reasoning holds. One drift: `island/index.jsx` — brief says `:88-90`, the `if`/`return` are at `:89-90` (`:88` is the `isEnabled` assignment).

**Probe** (headless Chromium via Playwright, `/tmp/pdp-probe/`, outside the repo, reproducing outer Stack → no-op Island → children):

| Gap | Before | After | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| panels sit below ProductView | 64px | 64px | **UNCHANGED** |
| panels → model line | **92px** | **28px** | fixed |
| pair → recommendations rail | 64px | 64px | **UNCHANGED** |

The probe reproduces the reported **92px** exactly before the fix, which is what makes the after-numbers trustworthy.

## 3. FIX 1 — the rewritten comment

> The accordions and the meta block deliberately share one `<Box>`, so the pair is a single flex item of the outer `<Stack spacing={16}>` rather than two. Chakra spaces a Stack with `gap` rather than a child selector, and `<Island>` emits no element of its own while `partialHydrationEnabled` is false, so anything left unwrapped in here is a direct child taking a 64px push from its neighbour. Sharing one item lands that 64px above the pair instead of between them, which leaves `ZimmProductMeta`'s recipe owning both 28px hops — the one below the accordions and the one between its own two rows. Hence no spacing props on the Box. The molecule returns null when it has neither value to show.

Every clause was checked against observable state, including the inherited null claim (`zimmProductMeta/index.tsx:43`) and `Box` already imported (`:29`).

## 4. FIX 2 — and a structural deviation you should rule on

Base's `aria-label` is at `:37`/`:49` and the `VisuallyHidden aria-live` region at `:57-66` — both exactly as the brief said. **I did not mirror either structurally.** What shipped:

```jsx
<chakra.p __css={styles} textStyle="price" data-testid="product-price" aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true">
```

**Why — and this was forced, not preferred.** I first implemented the literal instruction: a `VisuallyHidden aria-live="polite" aria-atomic={true}` sibling. G1/G2/G3/G5 passed. **G4 failed 3 tests.** `ZimmProductContent`'s `play` tests assert the *exact child count* of its flex column (`expected … to have a length of 2 but got 3`) across `WithoutDescription`, `RhythmWithDescription`, `BlankDescription`. The extra node is invisible and consumes no gap — I proved separately that Chakra's `VisuallyHidden` is `position:absolute` and adds **no** flex gap — but it is still a DOM child. Fixing those stories means editing a file outside my authorised path set, so the atom cannot add a node. Moving the live region onto the price element itself satisfies WCAG 4.1.3 with one node, and additionally avoids every screen reader reading the price twice on first load (base needs its second node only to order a `labelForA11y` product name ahead of the price — its own comment at `:56`; nothing supplies one here).

**The `aria-label` I deliberately omitted.** Its only function in base is to prepend localised words. Our atom takes `price` pre-formatted and pre-localised and has no `useIntl` — and there is **no `useIntl` precedent anywhere in `ui-kits/`** (I checked: `zimmSubscribeSection` uses `useUiCopy`, whose new keys live in a Tier 2 provider I can't open). An English-only literal would be an i18n defect across 11 locales; an `aria-label` equal to the visible text is a no-op for a screen reader. So the region announces the price alone. **Flagging both deviations for your ruling** rather than treating them as settled.

**Mutation proof** (4/4 caught, restored green each time): drop `aria-atomic` → caught; `polite`→`assertive` → caught; both attributes removed, i.e. exact pre-fix shape → caught; second hidden live node added back → caught by the single-node guard. Under the earlier sibling shape, nesting the copy inside the price was also caught by the *pre-existing* verbatim-text test.
